mission.goal: Close important retained inference inspection gaps with meaningful direct-main commits and no PRs.

published_checkpoints.change: Sealed retained frame/model read interface, bounded custody verification, historical executor inspection and seven library regressions.
Immutable native read/replay/detect/track commands, shared finite allowances, final validation before output/export, explicit executor compatibility and subprocess regressions.
Canonical CLI/MCP discovery of native scalar runs, exact source selectors and retained profile metadata, real receipt/root proof handles, metadata-only disclosure and mixed-producer compatibility.

cases.finding: Native read commands opened ReferenceDeployment and could acquire publisher custody or recover journals. The ordinary ReplayCx constructor also had a create_dir_all path.
cases.resolution: Canonical existing root, read-only ReplayCx constructor and ImmutableRetainedSource for every native inspection command; publication paths retain the mutable deployment.

cases.finding: Receipt decoding required the current executor source profile even for custody-only inspection.
cases.resolution: Preserve the original nonzero SHA-256 profile under exact receipt/run/manifest/delta bindings; enforce the current profile before numeric replay.

findings: The edited retained bridge does not change baseline or progressive codec fingerprints.
Decoded source, current masks/deletions, publication child counts, model, input and output share one immutable owner and original allowance.
Final validation precedes stdout and every export. A poisoned custody or read-budget state refuses even a partial detection report.
Valid computational partial reports and original historical completion anchors remain supported.
An empty final journal probe conservatively requires one remaining allowance byte even when it returns no payload.
Native model discovery verifies actual frame/import/capsule metadata and deletion authority without reading original media, pixels, model bytes or input/output tensors.

The generic model_invocation_receipt family also contains executor-activity JSON receipts; native discovery scopes its producer namespace and still refuses malformed declarations claiming that namespace.
Generic report handles identify the stored receipt; the distinct semantic run identity is disclosed only as a native reader selector, never as an available blob.
